lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines identified across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, with increased density and thinner line width observed in the anterior (shoulder) region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several posterior lines terminate midway down the torso; a distinct set of three abbreviated white segments or spots is positioned between the first and second full vertical lines near the rump.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area, specifically clustered below the termination of the vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower mid-torso align horizontally to form a secondary axis below the primary vertical line array.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white ocular spot located ventral to the eye; high-contrast white chevron mark across the bridge of the nose; large white patch visible on the lower throat/neck junction.
